label: Chronicle of St. Isidore
summary: The chronicle of Isidore of Seville.

claims.statement: Entered as no. 60 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Religion, Philosophy and History. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "the chronicle of Saint Isidore".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Chronica (Isidorus). The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
Composition and printing as given in the reconstruction: Composed 7th century · Printed 1472.
check_in: ISTC (Incunabula Short Title Catalogue) or Edit16 record for the edition
